template.name: The Neptunes
template.about: Dry, bright Triton-era synths, sparse 808 and claps, clavinet, short delays.

project.name: The Neptunes
project.notes:
THE NEPTUNES  (Pharrell Williams and Chad Hugo; c. 1998-2008)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- 2008: Pharrell sequenced on a Korg 01/W that triggered a Triton Extreme and a Triton Pro,
  synced to Pro Tools (Remix Magazine via theneptunes.org).

THIS TEMPLATE
Sparse 808-style rack at 54% (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), Surge XT "Fast Poly" for the bright synth, OB-Xf
clavinet and marcato strings, square synth bass. Keep parts few and dry.

MIX NOTES
- Dry and up-front: short room, slap delay; bright top (TDR VOS SlickEQ "2buss Presence").
- Drums loud and simple; the clap sits on top.
- Master: built-in glue, SlickEQ, Lemon Limiter; -9 to -8 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Medium. No Triton model: a Surge XT patch stands in. The drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
Remix Magazine (June 2008) via theneptunes.org; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TDR VOS SlickEQ (freeware (free edition, not GE)): https://www.tokyodawn.net/tdr-vos-slickeq/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 98 BPM, 4/4, key Ebmin, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (808) = kick-808.wav, Snare (808) = snare-808.wav, Closed Hat (808) = hat-808.wav, Open Hat (808) = openhat-808.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, Clap 505 = clap.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (15 steps on), swing 54% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- Synth Bass (Instrument, -5 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Square Bass"
- Bright Synth (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Polysynths/Fast Poly"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -16 dB
- Clav (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/Clavinet"
- Strings / Stabs (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Strings/Marcato Strings"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
- Falsetto Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -20 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -20 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 4, Release 100, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 0.5, Decay Curve 1, IR "00.5s Small Room")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 95, Feedback 0.1, Tone 3500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Channel EQ (High 1); Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Tokyo Dawn Labs: TDR VOS SlickEQ: factory preset "2buss Presence"; Lemon Limiter: gain +4 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
